artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two knights jousting on horseback. It shows two armored knights mounted on horses engaged in a jousting match. Both knights are clad in ornate suits of armor and wield lances aimed towards each other. The horses are also adorned with decorative trappings and are striding towards each other. One horse has an earthy toned cover, while the other has a blue cover embellishment with stars and a floral motif. The lances are shown with their tips creating a clash, with triangular paper flags being shredded and flying in the air. The composition conveys a dynamic sense of motion, capturing the moment of impact in the jousting tournament.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures on horseback engaged in a jousting event. The image depicts two knights riding horses adorned with elaborate and colorful caparisons. The knight on the left wears armor accented with green, red, and white geometric patterns. The headpiece of the knight on the right appears to be in motion. The lances of both knights are visible, with one broken on the ground. Around the head of the right knight, fragments of a shattered lance or accessory are flying. The scene captures the energy of a medieval tournament with focus on heraldry and pageantry.

artworks.title: The Apostle Simon Zelotes
artworks.creditLine: The Ahmanson Foundation and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing and facing slightly to the left. The individual holds a large saw in their left hand and grasps their clothing with the right hand. The person has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and a neutral expression. They have short hair covered by a hood or headdress indicating a halo. The clothing consists of a long robe with a cape draped over the shoulders, secured with buttons. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain with a simple line indicating the floor beneath them.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Appearing to Two Female Monastics
artworks.medium: pen and brown with gray wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures. In the center, a figure is slightly elevated, surrounded by smaller figures. The central figure has a serene expression, flowing hair covered by a draped veil. They hold a smaller figure in their lap. The surrounding figures seem to be cherubs or angels with wings. Below, two individuals kneel side by side, looking upwards with their hands extended. They wear long, flowing robes with hoods. The background features swirling clouds, creating a celestial atmosphere. The focus is on the figures' gestures and the surrounding environment.

artworks.title: Il calar della notte (Nightfall)
artworks.medium: etching in black with monotype wiping on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is not prominently defined, and a large, rocky or mountainous form dominates the right half of the composition. The lines show a meticulous, textured technique creating an intricate surface. The color palette consists of various shades of gray and black. Delicate leafy branches frame the scene from the top left and right corners, adding an organic element to the structured, rocky form in the distance.

artworks.title: Vision of Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch with several figures in a closely composed grouping. Most of the figures' upper bodies are depicted, one figure is seated with a child on their lap, and another figure is slightly reclined with an arm on the ground. The seated figure has downcast eyes and wears drapery over the head. The child has curly hair. The surrounding figures have curly and voluminous hair, and they are dressed in flowing robes with detailed folds. The seated figure and child have halos around their heads. The background features loosely sketched clouds, and the entire image is rendered in a soft, detailed etching style.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned in a seated manner with his right arm resting on an unseen surface or armrest while holding a rolled-up document in his right hand. His head is turned slightly towards his left side, giving a three-quarter view of his face. The man has curly hair, short and well-defined, framing his face, strong eyebrows, and a prominent straight nose. He appears to be wearing a period-style outfit consisting of a voluminous, flowing garment with a high white collar and a decorative necktie or scarf. In the background, there is a textured, shaded area which enhances the contrast with the figure.

artworks.title: Studies of Dogs and Men [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several hanging animal carcasses and a man's figure with a hat, amongst lightly sketched figures and objects. The drawing features two hanging animal carcasses on the left side of the composition with legs extended upwards. In the center-right, a lightly sketched figure wearing a hat, seen from the back, is holding a circular object. Beneath this figure, there is an incomplete sketch of a face in the bottom right-hand corner, as well as an area that could indicate a boot or shoe. This drawing is an unfinished study showing the artist's exploration of composition and form.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The central circular vignette is surrounded by four smaller ovals. The central image shows a figure in white drapery holding a flag, standing over another figure on the ground, with the phrase "Sic Semper Tyrannis" beneath it. The horizon line shows land with a faintly visible ship in the distance. The surrounding vignettes are connected by ornate floral designs with muted tones, each labeled with names like "Drenched Springs," "Harper's Ferry," "Mount Vernon," and "Monticello." The overall color palette consists of soft sepia tones and light greens with delicate outlines. The scenes are depicted with fine detail typical of 19th-century illustrative techniques.

artworks.title: Views of Weyers Cave
artworks.description: The image is a collection of four illustrations titled "Album of Virginia," focusing on various views of Weyer's Cave in Augusta County, Virginia, drawn by Ed. Beyer in 1856. The top-left image shows an outdoor scene with a group of people near the cave's entrance, with a small cabin surrounded by rocks and trees. The illustration to the right, labeled "Cataract," presents an interior cave view with stalactites and stalagmites. In the bottom left, the view labeled "Shell Room" features a vast cavern with illuminated formations admired by small human figures. The bottom right, titled "Cataract," showcases another interior with a high ceiling decorated with stalactites and a group of people gesturing towards the rock formations. Each scene is intricately detailed, suggesting a careful observational style that adds to the historical and visual richness of the album.

artworks.title: The Drums and the Tapestry Room, Weyers Cave
artworks.description: The image displays the interior of a large cave known as "The Tapestry Room" in Weyers Cave, Virginia. The viewpoint is from within the cave, looking deeper into its chambers. Several figures are standing on the left, while a couple are on natural steps to the right. The center showcases stalactites and stalagmites arranged around a large, flat rock formation. The scene is enclosed, with precise brushstrokes capturing textures and forms of the rocks. The color scheme is sepia and beige, creating a warm, historical atmosphere. Light areas highlight the cave, while shadows add depth.

artworks.title: U.S. Armory in Harpers Ferry
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of Harpers Ferry, featuring the U.S. Armory, a train on tracks, a horizon with hills, rocks, trees, and industrial buildings. The artwork is detailed with precise brushstrokes or etching techniques in soft earth tones.

artworks.title: Harpers Ferry from Jefferson Rock
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a river winding between two hills. Buildings, including a church with a steeple, are located on the left riverbank, and figures can be seen in the foreground. The colors in the image are primarily earthy tones, with fine brushstrokes capturing details of the scene. The sky shows a gradient from pale blue to soft yellowish off-white near the horizon.

artworks.title: View of the Peaks of Otter
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a valley leading towards two mountain peaks known as the Peaks of Otter. The horizon is low, with the mountains dominating the scene. The brushwork is smooth and delicate, and the color palette consists of muted earth tones, greens, and soft blues. In the foreground, there are cattle grazing in a field with a wooden fence, and a couple of houses among trees to the left. Further back, there are open fields with horses and agricultural activities, leading to a dense tree line at the base of the mountains.

artworks.title: View from the Peak of Otter, No. 2
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking a landscape of rolling hills and valleys. On the right, there are large rock formations with people nearby. In the distance, there are mountains silhouetted against a pale sky. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes creating a soft, illustrative quality. The color palette includes earth tones with variations of browns, beige, and light greens in the hills and valleys. The sky is primarily soft gray, transitioning into lighter hues.

artworks.title: View from the Peak of Otter, No. 1
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, valleys, and distant mountains. Figures are standing on rocks in the foreground, and there are settlements in the mid-ground. The color palette includes earth tones and the brushstrokes are detailed. The sky has light clouds.

artworks.title: White Sulphur Springs
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape titled "White Sulphur Springs." A range of wooded hills is in the background with buildings of various sizes scattered among trees and rolling terrain. A large structure is prominent on the right side. The brushstrokes appear detailed, capturing architectural and natural details. The color palette consists of primarily sepia tones. Trees, grass patches, and paths are visible, along with several horse-drawn carriages.

artworks.title: Natural Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows the Natural Bridge in Virginia, viewed from ground level looking slightly upwards. The Natural Bridge dominates the composition, with trees and bushes growing on top. Small figures can be seen at the edge. The rock surfaces and foliage are detailed, and the color palette is muted. Close to the viewer, plants and rocks edge a reflective pool of water.

artworks.title: Natural Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows a natural arch bridge surrounded by trees. The view is from slightly above eye level, with detailed print technique emphasizing textures in rocks and leaves. The color palette is mainly shades of brown and green, giving a nostalgic feel. In the foreground, a rocky path with two figures in period clothing can be seen, and in the distance, more trees and rocks are visible through the arch.

artworks.title: Natural Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of Natural Bridge in Virginia. The perspective is from an elevated point, offering a wide panorama of the landscape. Closest to us, there is a fenced area with a couple of figures and a horse. Beyond this, the view shows trees, rolling hills, buildings and houses. The horizon line is high, with soft clouds in the sky. In the center, Natural Bridge is surrounded by lush vegetation. The illustration has precise and detailed brushstrokes and a warm color palette of sepia and light browns.

artworks.title: Burner's White Sulphur Spring, Shenandoah County
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with hills, mountains, a valley, buildings, trees, and people.

artworks.title: Fauquier White Sulphur Springs
artworks.description: The image shows a historic landscape of the Fauquier White Sulphur Springs estate in Virginia. The scene includes gentle rolling hills, a row of trees, a large building on a hill with smaller structures and trees around it, a meadow with figures and a carriage, and ornate architectural features among the trees. The visual style is detailed with fine lines and subtle shading, creating depth in the landscape. The color palette is muted with natural greens and browns.

artworks.title: White Sulphur Spring, Montgomery County
artworks.description: The image displays a birds-eye view of the White Sulphur Spring in Montgomery County. The landscape features a mountain range, a cloudy sky, forests, buildings arranged in a semi-circle, a formal garden with a fountain, and paths. The style appears to be a lithograph with detailed lines and shading. The color palette consists of muted greens, browns, and grays. A fence line borders the composition.

artworks.title: View from the Hawks Nest
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view from an elevated vantage point, capturing a winding river through a valley of hills. The horizon is near the top, below the sky meeting mountains. In the distance, hills fade into softer tones, enhancing the landscape's depth. Close by, a small group of people stand on a rocky outcrop, surrounded by trees and shrubs, adding scale. The artwork appears to be a lithograph with detailed lines, stippled textures, and a color palette of muted sepia, green, and grey.
